about_short_description.short_description: Monak e-Services is an online Shopping and Services App in Oman.

product.name: Banking Services
product.description: Provides local bank accounts, debit cards, remittance, microfinance, and foreign exchange services for users in the Middle East.

product.name: Health Services
product.description: Includes medical visa processing, health packages, online pharmacy access, and insurance management through the app.

product.name: Daily Essentials Services
product.description: Offers grocery and food delivery, taxi booking, bill payments, and other daily convenience services through the app.

product.name: Recruiter Onboarding Software
product.description: A software solution for recruiters to onboard, process, and track expat workforce efficiently in the Middle East.

product.name: Recruiter Support Services
product.description: Provides embedded services like flight bookings, PRO services, airport transfers, and a support ticket system for recruiters.
